violations.description: General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. Excessive amount of ice build up in walk in freezer.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. Ice machine in kitchen has a build up of debris on splash guard. Ice machine in need of detail cleaning.--Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Food debris build up on can opener blade. Device in need of detail cleaning.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Build up of food debris in microwave. In need of detail cleaning.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Insides of all hot and cold food storage devices in need of a thorough deep clean. Build up of food debris present throughout kitchen.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Shelving inside of walk in cooler has a build up of debris. Shelving in need of detail cleaning.--Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. Build up of grease on hood system filters. Filters in need of detail cleaning.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. Single-service items in prep area across from fryers are stored in a container that has a build up of food debris.

Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was not provided in sufficient number and/or not accessible to allow convenient use by employees. Hand sink in bar area is blocked by storage boxes and not accessible.

Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of individual disposable towels, continuous towel supply system, or heated air-drying device. Hand sink in bar area did not have a supply of paper towels.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Dust collecting around ceiling vent fans. Ceiling in need of detail cleaning.--Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floors and walls throughout kitchen in need of a thorough detail clean. Food debris buildup throughout kitchen.

Person in charge. — --Certified food service manager had an expired certificate or is no longer associated with this establishment. Certificate found expired for listed food service manager. This person is also no longer associated with the facility. Facility should have a manager certified in food safety as soon as possible.

Preventing contamination by consumers. — --Food on display for self service was not properly protected by food guards, display cases, or similarly effective means. Ice cream cones found near the ice cream machine were found without protection from consumers. Cones should be provided with a lid on the container or sneeze guard to protect them from contamination.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. The blade for the commercial manual can opener was found dirty. This should be cleaned and maintained clean.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Refrigerated prep tables, reach-in hot and cold pass through cabinets, inside of microwave, walk-in cooler shelves and the outside of the pizza ovens were found dirty during inspection. These area should be cleaned and maintained clean.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Ceiling tiles and vents in the dish room were found dirty. These should be cleaned and maintained clean.
